purpose: Operational pilot of the guarded prospective MA reaction workflow; not a claim about the full BIST universe.

universe.selection_rule: Fixed repository pilot universe chosen before this cohort is scanned; membership does not change within the cohort.

scan.period_selection_rule: Conventional short, medium and long daily trend horizons fixed before any v2 result was generated.
scan.configuration_source: The complete AnalysisConfig and source fingerprint are copied from run_metadata.json into every ledger row.

enrollment.comparison_rule: CANDIDATE_ONLY rows are reported separately and can never satisfy the promotion rule.

execution.entry: First eligible independent touch strictly after the scan cut-off.
execution.ambiguous_bar_policy: Conservative: simultaneous target and stop counts as STOP.

decision_rule.promotion: All three thresholds must be met. Until then the result is INCONCLUSIVE and notifications remain disabled.
decision_rule.failure: At or after 30 resolved CERTIFIED watches, target rate below 0.50 or median net fixed return at or below zero rejects this cohort.

change_control: Any change to universe, timeframe, MA family, periods, touch definition, horizon, target, stop, FDR, null controls or costs creates a new cohort identifier.
